title: Plans are still untested
literal_meaning: Planned beforehand, yet all still raw!
explanation: An advance plan may look settled until circumstances put it to the test. The source explains the line as a warning that earlier arrangements can fall apart at the appointed time. It tempers certainty without making preparation itself pointless.
meaning_odia: ଭଲ ଭାବି ରଖିଥିବା ଯୋଜନା ବି ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ବଦଳିଲେ ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ରହିପାରେ। ମନରେ ଥିବା ଆୟୋଜନ ଓ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ଯାହା ହେଲା, ତାହାର ଅମେଳକୁ କଥାଟି ଧରେ। ଏଥିରେ ନିରାଶାର ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଯୋଜନା କରିବା ନିରର୍ଥକ ବୋଲି ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Friends confidently divide festival duties, then discover on the day that several people cannot come. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
